## Overview

Inline range calendar. Picking a new start clears the previous end; the second pick commits a sorted range.

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Export as:** `qzDateRangePicker`
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/date-picker/date-range-picker.directive.ts:37](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/date-picker/date-range-picker.directive.ts#L37)

